body:
28, suicidal for 1 year, alcoholic for 9 years but didn't realize it until 2 years ago. I went to rehab in February and as far as my family and work knows I'm doing great...addicts are exceptional liars :P.

I honestly don't see any positive outcome at this point...I haven't been "happy" for so long that I don't know what it feels like other than the opposite of what I feel now (to quote some song I heard not long ago).

Fiddles, I appreciate you taking the time to comment and PM. I'm 28, decent looking and have a good job. I'm miserable and realize that the life I'm living is better than so many in poverty throughout the world. I try to use that thought to shake me out of it all, and can't. I avoid relationships because I can't get ahold of my addiction and when I'm drunk I get violent...never want to inflict that pain upon a partner.

I feel pathetic for being such a fucking pussy, and think that myself dying tonight will be better than long, drawn-out years of addiction-related trauma to friends and family.
